args.goal: Prepare the catalogue-specific operator handoff for converting one verified eligible inquiry into an administratively accepted order. First check for an equivalent committed handoff and reuse it if present. Read docs/INTERAC-COMMANDES.md, the existing welfare payment handoff as a workflow reference, and the committed catalogue draft, brief-decision evidence and rehearsal. Produce one copy-ready EN/FR scope confirmation and one concise operator checklist for a real inquiry. Use exact supported inputs and keep/correct/resolve-manually outputs. Leave any quote, buyer assent and order reference pending actual operator evidence. Carry over no welfare price or terms. Verify the handoff against the fictional B-02 case and a counterexample with missing approval evidence. Record what evidence establishes a qualified inquiry, administrative acceptance, delivery and founder-confirmed Treasury posting. Save and read the artifacts before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. This handoff can proceed while the catalogue candidate awaits independent review. Use no private case data, external send, order creation, payment instructions, spend or deployment.
